text:
evan: Quick one — UX decision: when folks click from Route -> Model in Console analytics, do we bring filters along (time, query, tags) or show a clean model-first slate?

marta: Bring time + query text + model tag for continuity. Route-specific filters (region, rollout group, capacity pool) should be shown but clearly inactive.

hugo: I like inactive-but-visible. Avoid surprising users by silently dropping things. Put a subtle inline pill: "route-only" that is disabled.

nia: From infra side, we should not change saved_query API. We store scope as route|model|global, that stays. Client can compute applicability and render scope badges.

sam: Telemetry asks: emit analytics.saved_query_applied with origin (route|model|cross) and applied_predicates_count. Also emit analytics.filters_pruned { reason, count } when we drop unsupported predicates.

evan: Good. UX copy: banner in model view: "Some filters are route-scoped and not active here — open route to compare full set." CTA: "Open route with these filters".

marta: For saved-query listing when route+model params present: show exact matches first, then model-scoped, then global. Use small scope chips on each item (ROUTE / MODEL / GLOBAL).

hugo: Implementation: fetch saved queries once, filter client-side. Avoid new endpoints. Also add a client-side whitelist check so we can prune unsupported predicate keys consistently.

nia: I'll reserve telemetry keys and add kinesis schema entries. Also add infra ticket infra#4721 to track pruned-filters spikes.

sam: Edge-case: rollout predicates — we must not apply them in model view. Show them as disabled and when user clicks CTA open route deep-link with the full predicate set preserved. Deep-link pattern: /console/route/{id}?filters={encoded}&t={time}.

evan: Also surface cost/preview staleness: if cost shown came from the route's quota override, banner should say "Cost preview is route-specific and may differ in model view."

deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled tomorrow 07:30 PT under flag preserve-context-modelview. Reply here to opt out.

marta: Next steps: Nia adds telemetry schema + infra ticket; Hugo adds client prune/lint and deep-link helper; Sam adds analytics events; I'll mock scope chips and banner microcopy; Evan will draft a short RFC capturing non-breaking API approach. We reconvene after canary metrics land.
